title: ophrys oestrifera subsp. bicornis
intro: Ophrys oestrifera subsp. bicornis, commonly known as the Bee Orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid found in the Mediterranean region. It belongs to the Ophrys genus and is prized for its unique, bee-like flowers that attract pollinators. The Bee Orchid has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys oestrifera subsp. bicornis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
